Historical alternate-art full-card image of [[Artoo, Brave Little Droid (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith) (Original)|Artoo, Brave Little Droid]], matching the [[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith]] publisher slip. It uses the Virtual slip’s text with alternate artwork. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.

== Source ==
* Package: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/holotable/windows/holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe] (Story #419).
* Distribution member: <code>cards/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/artoobravelittledroidai.GIF</code>.

* Preserved member: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/billbisco/swccg-holotable/033d17f68e6ac51848323d353216a685f920f575/historical-recovery/419/large-v17/cards/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/artoobravelittledroidai.GIF alternate-art GIF] ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/billbisco/swccg-holotable/033d17f68e6ac51848323d353216a685f920f575/historical-recovery/419/metadata/large-v17-virtual-manifest.json package-member manifest]).
